title: Official WordPress Browser Extension Launches
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…there's now an official WordPress browser extension for Chrome and Safari?

It hides the clunky admin bar while keeping quick shortcuts to your dashboard just one click away — plus handy dev tools like block outlines and a cache-busting reload.

Everything runs locally on your device, nothing gets tracked. Built by the community, now officially supported by WordPress. Give it a spin!
